falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern assumed a higher low formation; breaking 4,800 would violate the structural support level of that pattern and confirm continuation lower, not a bottom

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A blowoff score of 40 suggests controlled volatility/early recovery; sustained VIX above 35 indicates panic regime continuation, invalidating the bottoming thesis

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield spread inverts further by 15+ basis points from current level
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Deepening inversion contradicts the bottom_2024_aug pattern which featured curve steepening; this would signal worsening growth expectations and credit stress, not stabilization

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
